NO_WARRANTY_ACTION.label: No warranty action
NO_WARRANTY_ACTION.description: The available evidence does not support a warranty intervention.
NO_WARRANTY_ACTION.required_next_step: Retain the report and continue normal monitoring.

SOFTWARE_CORRECTION_FIRST.label: Software correction first
SOFTWARE_CORRECTION_FIRST.description: Software configuration should be corrected and retested before hardware replacement is considered.
SOFTWARE_CORRECTION_FIRST.required_next_step: Verify the approved software package, program when applicable, clear faults and repeat the assessment.

FURTHER_DIAGNOSTIC_REQUIRED.label: Further diagnostic required
FURTHER_DIAGNOSTIC_REQUIRED.description: The evidence is insufficient to authorize replacement or software-only correction.
FURTHER_DIAGNOSTIC_REQUIRED.required_next_step: Follow the OEM diagnostic test plan and collect additional objective evidence.

HARDWARE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.label: Hardware verification required
HARDWARE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.description: Hardware or part-number compatibility must be confirmed before a warranty decision.
HARDWARE_VERIFICATION_REQUIRED.required_next_step: Verify the installed ECU, replacement history, physical part number and compatibility.

REPLACEMENT_REVIEW.label: Replacement review
REPLACEMENT_REVIEW.description: Replacement may be considered only after the specified diagnostic and configuration checks are completed.
REPLACEMENT_REVIEW.required_next_step: Obtain engineering or warranty authorization after confirming the fault and excluding programming/configuration causes.

ENGINEERING_ESCALATION.label: Engineering escalation
ENGINEERING_ESCALATION.description: The vehicle contains critical, mixed or unresolved evidence requiring engineering review.
ENGINEERING_ESCALATION.required_next_step: Escalate the complete report, logs and vehicle history to the responsible engineering owner.

disclaimer: This is a decision-support recommendation and not an automatic warranty authorization.
